name: 蘇育民
objective:
本課主要以實例演練、訓練學生對施工圖樣、施工規範及施工實務之瞭解，並熟練數量計算及單價分析之方法及要點。主要授課內容含蓋：1. 講授各項工程施工規範之標準、2. 以實例訓練各項工程數量計算及單價分析：a. 假設工程 b. 安全措施工程 c. 土方工程 d. 混凝土工程 e. 模板工程 f. 鋼筋工程 g. 磚牆工程 h. 粉刷及裝修工程 i. 雜項工程。
The main purpose of this course is training students to comprehend the working drawings, the performance standards and the affairs of works by drilling actual example. This course makes students to be familiar with not only calculating the quantity but also the essentials and the methods in analyzing the unite price. The lesson's contents include: 
A.	To teach the standards of every performance standard. 
B.	To train calculating and analyzing the unite price of every work.
1.	Temporary work 
2.	Safety measure work 
3.	Earthwork
4.	Concrete work
5.	Mold work
6.	Reinforcement work
7.	Partition work
8.	Plaster, decoration and finish work
9.	Miscellaneous work
課程進度(1-16週):
W1 課程介紹及 QA
W2 營建施工項目種類介紹 分類
W3 營建施工項目工作流程 前期規劃
W4 施工項目分類及 PCCES 介紹及應用
W5 雜項工程規範
W6 土方工程規範
W7 結構工程規範_基礎工程 A
W8 期中考週 (繳交報告)
W9 期中報告討論回顧
W10 結構工程規範_基礎工程 B
W11 結構工程規範_模板工程
W12 結構工程規範_鋼筋工程
W13 機電消防空調規範介紹
W14 裝修工程規範_公區工程
W15 裝修工程規範_細部裝修
W16 總回顧
W17-18 期末報告撰寫暨心得回顧

延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
